meta.name: The Chosen One
meta.description:
After surviving a freak accident, Jodie, a twelve-year-old boy from Santa Rosalía, Baja California Sur, discovers that he has Jesus-like powers: He can turn water into wine, make the crippled walk, and perhaps even raise the dead. How will he deal with his destiny and lead the world through a conflict that’s been thousands of years in the making?

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: The Arrival
videos.overview: Tuka’s missing uncle turns up, setting off a search for a mythical creature that will take Jodie and the group into uncharted, dangerous territory.

videos.title: Miracles?
videos.overview: In the wake of Jodie’s new local fame, Sarah shares further details about his father — and their fate. The kids put on a show featuring a shocking trick.

videos.title: The Awakening
videos.overview: Jodie and Tuka are accused of blasphemy. Jodie urges Sarah to reveal any further secrets. Overwhelmed by his new identity, Jodie visits Father O’Higgins.

videos.title: True or False?
videos.overview: Sarah’s pregnancy story is revealed. Jodie visits Principal Hernandez's home. A mysterious new man in town asks about the “Miracle Child.”

videos.title: Faith
videos.overview: As Jodie embraces his role as the town healer, new followers display their devotion. Magda grapples with disappointment. Ángelo's anger intensifies.

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: Some residents of Santa Rosalía come together in mourning, while others unite in wrath. Will Jodie be able to calm the town's troubled waters?

meta.slogan: Who is he really? Why is he running away?
